description: Returns loans in public CMBS trusts that match your filters, largest balance first unless sorted, with the total match count and total balance. Use it to find a loan or property by name, address, city or ZIP, or to screen by status, type, state, metro, tenant, maturity, balance, coverage, occupancy, rate, vintage, servicer, originator or trust. All filters are optional and combine; no match returns an empty list and a total of 0. Use get_loan for one loan's full record and tenant_exposure to rank tenants.

cbsa.description: Census CBSA metro code, e.g. 35620 for New York

limit.description: Results per call: up to 10 free, 100 with a Pro or Team key

max_occupancy.description: Maximum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent

max_rate.description: Maximum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent

min_occupancy.description: Minimum latest occupancy, as a fraction or percent: 0.8 or 80

min_rate.description: Minimum current interest rate, as a fraction or percent: 0.05 or 5

offset.description: For paging: free stops at the first 25 results; Pro and Team page through everything

originator.description: Originator, or part of the name, e.g. "Wells Fargo"

q.description: Word starts in the property name, street address, ZIP, city, metro, state, property type or trust name, e.g. "times square", "825 Eighth Avenue" or "houston office"

special_servicer.description: Trust's special servicer: finds loans in trusts whose general special servicer is this name, or part of it, e.g. "Rialto". A given loan may be serviced by someone else

status.description: Loan condition, or a Schedule AL status as filed: foreclosure, reo (real estate owned), forbearance or extended (a modification dated in the last 24 months)

tenant.description: A tenant named among the three largest, e.g. "Walgreens"

trust.description: Only loans in this trust, by slug, e.g. "benchmark-2018-b8"

name: search_loans
title: Search CMBS loans
